llms.body:
# Shop

> [Shop](https://shop.com) is Shopify's shopping app and web storefront. Discover products from millions of Shopify stores, check out with Shop Pay, and track every order in one place, including orders you placed somewhere else. Agents can shop the same catalog: start at https://shop.com/SKILL.md.

## For Agents

- [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md): **Start here.** Search by text or image, find similar products, compare options, build and update carts and checkouts, and buy with Shop Pay. Connect Shop to use saved addresses and cards, view spending budgets, request approval for purchases completed in a browser, and search order history to track deliveries or reorder. Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, and purchase-approval rules.
- [Shop CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/shop): Install the command and its bundled skill with `npm install --global @shopify/shop@latest && shop skill --install`. Use `shop --help` to discover commands and `shop skill` to read the guidance.
- [HTTP reference](https://shop.com/references/http.md): Use Shop through `https://mcp.shop.com/` when neither the CLI nor native MCP is available. Includes request examples, discovery, and sign-in guidance.
- [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://www.shopify.com/ucp): The open standard behind agentic commerce on Shopify. Agents discover products, build carts, check out, and track orders across any UCP merchant, with Shop Pay built in.

## URL Structure

Public pages follow these patterns:

- `/products/{id}/{handle}` - a single product, with pricing, variants, and reviews. For example, https://shop.com/products/7934502174785/seiko-essentials-ssb429-chronograph-watch
- `/categories/{id}/{handle}` - a Shop taxonomy category page
- `/m/{store}` - a brand's storefront on Shop, with its own products and reviews
- `/m/{store}/collections/{id}/{handle}` - a collection within a storefront

Use the sitemaps below to enumerate real values for `{id}`, `{handle}`, and `{store}`.

`/account` needs a signed-in session. `/cart` and `/tracking/{token}` do not, but each one shows data for a single shopper. Do not crawl these paths. Get order and tracking data through the skill instead.

## Discover All Pages

Sitemaps list public pages:

- https://shop.com/sitemap.xml
- https://shop.com/sitemap_categories.xml
- https://shop.com/cdn/shopifycloud/shop-web/sitemaps/shop-com/products/sitemap_products.xml
- https://shop.com/cdn/shopifycloud/shop-web/sitemaps/shop-com/collections/sitemap_collections.xml
- https://shop.com/cdn/shopifycloud/shop-web/sitemaps/shop-com/storefronts/sitemap_storefronts.xml

## Legal and Policies

- [Legal and policies](https://shop.com/legal-and-policies): Every Shop policy in one index.
- [Terms of service](https://shop.com/terms-of-service): The terms that cover using Shop.
- [Privacy policy](https://shop.com/privacy): What Shop collects, how it is used, and your choices.
- [Shop Cash terms](https://shop.com/shop-cash-terms): The terms that cover earning and spending Shop Cash.
- [Licenses](https://shop.com/licenses): Open-source licenses for the Shop [iOS](https://shop.com/licenses/ios) and [Android](https://shop.com/licenses/android) apps.

## Need Help?

- [Shop help](https://help.shopify.com/en/shop): How to use Shop, track orders, manage your account, and get support. Append `.md` to any page for clean Markdown.
- [Shop for merchants](https://www.shopify.com/shop): How selling on Shop works, with no marketplace fees.
- [Checkout Kit](https://www.shopify.com/checkout-kit): The official way to embed Shopify checkout in your app or platform.

# Shop

> [Shop](https://shop.com) is Shopify's shopping app and web storefront. Discover products from millions of Shopify stores, check out with Shop Pay, and track every order in one place, including orders you placed somewhere else. Agents can shop the same catalog: start at https://shop.com/SKILL.md.

## For Agents

- [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md): **Start here.** Search by text or image, find similar products, compare options, build and update carts and checkouts, and buy with Shop Pay. Connect Shop to use saved addresses and cards, view spending budgets, request approval for purchases completed in a browser, and search order history to track deliveries or reorder. Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, and purchase-approval rules.
- [Shop CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/shop): Install the command and its bundled skill with `npm install --global @shopify/shop@latest && shop skill --install`. Use `shop --help` to discover commands and `shop skill` to read the guidance.
- [HTTP reference](https://shop.com/references/http.md): Use Shop through `https://mcp.shop.com/` when neither the CLI nor native MCP is available. Includes request examples, discovery, and sign-in guidance.
- [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://www.shopify.com/ucp): The open standard behind agentic commerce on Shopify. Agents discover products, build carts, check out, and track orders across any UCP merchant, with Shop Pay built in.

## URL Structure

Public pages follow these patterns:

- `/products/{id}/{handle}` - a single product, with pricing, variants, and reviews. For example, https://shop.com/products/7934502174785/seiko-essentials-ssb429-chronograph-watch
- `/categories/{id}/{handle}` - a Shop taxonomy category page
- `/m/{store}` - a brand's storefront on Shop, with its own products and reviews
- `/m/{store}/collections/{id}/{handle}` - a collection within a storefront

Use the sitemaps below to enumerate real values for `{id}`, `{handle}`, and `{store}`.

`/account` needs a signed-in session. `/cart` and `/tracking/{token}` do not, but each one shows data for a single shopper. Do not crawl these paths. Get order and tracking data through the skill instead.

## Discover All Pages

Sitemaps list public pages:

- https://shop.com/sitemap.xml
- https://shop.com/sitemap_categories.xml
- https://shop.com/cdn/shopifycloud/shop-web/sitemaps/shop-com/products/sitemap_products.xml
- https://shop.com/cdn/shopifycloud/shop-web/sitemaps/shop-com/collections/sitemap_collections.xml
- https://shop.com/cdn/shopifycloud/shop-web/sitemaps/shop-com/storefronts/sitemap_storefronts.xml

## Legal and Policies

- [Legal and policies](https://shop.com/legal-and-policies): Every Shop policy in one index.
- [Terms of service](https://shop.com/terms-of-service): The terms that cover using Shop.
- [Privacy policy](https://shop.com/privacy): What Shop collects, how it is used, and your choices.
- [Shop Cash terms](https://shop.com/shop-cash-terms): The terms that cover earning and spending Shop Cash.
- [Licenses](https://shop.com/licenses): Open-source licenses for the Shop [iOS](https://shop.com/licenses/ios) and [Android](https://shop.com/licenses/android) apps.

## Need Help?

- [Shop help](https://help.shopify.com/en/shop): How to use Shop, track orders, manage your account, and get support. Append `.md` to any page for clean Markdown.
- [Shop for merchants](https://www.shopify.com/shop): How selling on Shop works, with no marketplace fees.
- [Checkout Kit](https://www.shopify.com/checkout-kit): The official way to embed Shopify checkout in your app or platform.
